name: export_memory_as_agent_skill
title: Export Memory as Agent Skill
description: Guide an LLM to turn recalled Dense-Mem experience into a shareable Agent Skill SKILL.md file.

arguments.name: topic
arguments.description: Experience or memory area to export.

arguments.name: scope_notes
arguments.description: Optional constraints about what to include or exclude.

name: migrate_legacy_memory_v2
title: Migrate Legacy Memory to Semantic Edges
description: Guide a manager LLM through one user-confirmed, independently verified legacy-memory decomposition into atomic semantic assertions.

arguments.name: legacy_type
arguments.description: Legacy memory type: fragment, claim, fact, or dream.

arguments.name: legacy_content
arguments.description: Exact legacy memory content when already available.
